ci_method.pairing: For each task and intent, resample the same example indices for both methods and every validation checkpoint. Thus AUC intervals retain within-example temporal dependence. Boundary intervals also reuse each old example's draw across repeated task boundaries.
ci_method.strata: Twenty test or ten validation examples per intent; intent/task identities are fixed, not resampled.
ci_method.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of 50000 paired contrast replicates; estimates and intervals are conditional on these trained models and selected tasks.

decision.classification: negative screening result for beneficial selective renewal in this regime
decision.reason: Near-ceiling new-task acquisition is preserved by every method. Selective renewal adds at most a small, task-dependent acquisition AUC gain while losing substantially more old-task global accuracy than optimizer reset; there is no evidence of sustained loss of acquisition ability to repair on this four-task stream.
decision.mechanism_boundary: The observed retention harm appears during subsequent adaptation, not as net immediate heldout accuracy damage at reset boundaries. Task-local accuracy diagnoses both class competition and some lost within-task discrimination; neither mechanism is isolated causally by this run.
decision.expansion: Do not scale this renewal candidate to model-size or seed matrices based on this result. The useful outcome is a validated interference assay and a negative result for this heuristic, conditional on the tested seed/tasks/budget.
limits: One training seed and one four-task order; test-example confidence intervals do not quantify training-seed, order, task-selection or model uncertainty.
All accuracy intervals are pointwise, exploratory paired stratified percentile bootstrap intervals. They are not multiplicity-corrected confirmatory tests.
Only global per-example predictions are stored. Task-local accuracies and losses have no computable paired per-example CI in these receipts.
Ceiling endpoints can have empirically degenerate bootstrap intervals; these are not equivalence proofs.
The early-eight-update analysis is a post-hoc diagnostic; fixed 32-update budgets and final endpoints were not changed.
Public English intent classification with arbitrary codes does not establish general continual intelligence or pretraining-independent novel skill acquisition.
No causal claim that shortening the 32-update tasks would repair forgetting can be made: old-task retention was measured at boundaries and endpoints, not throughout new-task training.
